Đường thẳng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi></mrow></semantics></math> đi qua điểm <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>6</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>

variants.solution: Giao điểm của <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi></mrow></semantics></math> và <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> có tổng hoành độ bằng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></semantics></math>, hình chiếu của <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>I</mi></mrow></semantics></math> lên <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>P</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> là <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>H</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>;</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mn>5</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>.
